notes.title: 6000+ Downloads And New Game Announcement!!!
notes.content:
Hi, Its Prateek here. And I am the person who created this game.

I was looking at the download figures today, and I see that there are 6000+ downloads for this game. This is simply BREATHTAKING!! And I thank you all for playing this game.

6000+ is a huge figure for this game. And I am glad a lot of people like it. 

[h1]New Game Details: [/h1]

I would also like to tell you all about a new game game that I am working on. 


It's called "Brocula". [b]It is about a vampire who has slept for 500 years. And now he wakes up in a changed world where his money is useless. So he needs to start from scratch. Upgrade his Castle, and survive in this town.[/b]


You can visit the game site and subscribe to the newsletter for announcements like Steam release timelines and development about this game here : [url=https://brocula.com]https://brocula.com[/url]


If you are on social media. Here are the social media links that you can follow the game on.

notes.title: Chopper to Hell is now for $3.99
notes.content:
For people who are stuck at home and who would like to take out frustration, I have a good news for you guys. The game is now discounted permanently to $3.99. 

Things to look forward to
1. Five stages for pure spider killing. 
2. Nightmare mode for extra frustrated people.
3. Explosions!!! Explosions everywhere!!!

notes.title: Chopper To Hell is Released!!!
notes.content:
The game is finally [b]released[/b] after months of development.

There are a bunch of tips that I would like to share:
[list]
[*] Do not let yourself be surrounded on all sides. It becomes overwhelming and your death is pretty sure.
[*] If you get surrounded, use [b]FlameThrower[/b]!!
[*] Medkits and Ammo Boxes will save you at all times.
[/list]

I hope you guys will enjoy playing this game!!
